summary: Add 15-slot inventory bag editor to the archive site's save-file editor. Each slot exposes a dropdown of every game item (EN name) plus a quantity input (1..255); selecting (empty) clears the slot to the sentinel ff ff ff ff ff 00. Reads the 6-byte records at body 0x1D9B6 stride 6 and mirrors writes to both slot A and slot B following the existing write-both pattern. The iid<->stored_value bijection (3346 items) was cracked in the translation repo via ARM9 lookup function 0x0200BB2C and per-category base/count tables, and is shipped to the browser as public/data/inventory_encoding.json.
